user.title: Mealie Browser
user.description: Mealie Browser reuses the connection of the Mealie integration: choose the Mealie server to browse.

abort.mealie_not_configured: Set up the Mealie integration first: Mealie Browser reuses its connection.

init.title: Open recipe by voice
init.description: Defaults used by the open_recipe_by_voice action when the call does not provide them.

data.dashboard_path: Path of the dashboard view showing the card

data_description.browser_id: Browser to steer to the recipes view (needs browser_mod). Leave empty to show the recipe on every open card without navigating.
data_description.dashboard_path: For example /dashboard-kitchen/recipes. Only used with a browser ID.
data_description.resend_delay: 0 to disable. Useful for a tablet whose web view reloads a few seconds after waking up.

open_recipe_by_voice.name: Open recipe by voice
open_recipe_by_voice.description: Finds the Mealie recipe matching a spoken phrase (recipe extras first, then the recipe name) and shows it on the Mealie Browser card. Shows a search for the phrase when no recipe matches.

text.name: Text
text.description: Phrase to match, for example what was said to a voice assistant.

browser_id.name: Browser ID
browser_id.description: browser_mod ID of the browser that should show the recipe. Defaults to the integration options.

dashboard_path.name: Dashboard path
dashboard_path.description: View holding the card, opened on that browser first. Defaults to the integration options.

not_loaded.message: Mealie Browser is not set up.

mealie_entry_missing.message: The Mealie integration entry used by Mealie Browser no longer exists. Remove and add Mealie Browser again.

deprecated_yaml.title: Mealie Browser YAML configuration is deprecated
deprecated_yaml.description: Mealie Browser is now set up from the UI and your configuration has been imported. Remove `mealie_browser:` from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant.
